CATEGORIES:
- measure_word_choice (grammar): 量词选择 -- Use the appropriate measure word for the noun, including polite 位 and noun-specific classifiers such as 棵.
- numeral_measure_word_order (grammar): Num. + MW. + N., no 的 -- With a number and measure word, use Num. + MW. + noun directly; normally do not add 的. Use V. + Num. + MW. + Obj. in the normal object order.
- modifier_de_structure (grammar): 的 in modifier phrases -- Use 的 only where a modifier needs it, and omit it in structures that do not take 的. A descriptive modifier before a noun normally needs the appropriate 的 structure.
- adjective_predicate_degree (grammar): Adj. can be predicate; usually Adj. takes 很 -- An adjective can be the predicate without 是. Usually use 很 before an adjective when giving a plain description, unless another degree pattern is intended.
- non_adjective_degree_patterns (grammar): 病 is not a normal Adj. -- Do not treat verbs or nouns such as 病 / 生病 as ordinary adjectives with 很 or 不. Use patterns such as 病得很厉害 when describing the degree.
- verb_object_valency (grammar): V. + Obj. structure -- Use each verb with the object and complement structure it allows; do not give a verb an extra object or omit a required one.
- verb_reduplication_requests (grammar): V.V. for requests or plans -- Use V.V. to make a request or express a tentative plan, not simply for any completed narrative action.
- modal_and_control_verb_complements (grammar): 想 + V.; 叫/让 + V. -- 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun. Control and modal-like verbs such as 叫/让 take a following action and do not take 了 in this use.
- location_with_zai (grammar): 在+Place / 在Place + V. -- Use 在 + Place for a location, and place the location correctly before the action when needed: 在Place + V. or 住在+Place.
- directional_complements (grammar): V. + directional complement + Place + 来/去 -- Use directional complements in the correct order, for example 走到place来/去 and V. + directional complement + Place + 来/去. Do not use forms such as 走去 or 走来Place.
- resultative_complements (grammar): resultative complement -- Use a resultative complement when the action has reached its result, for example 吃到, 找到, 撞到, 把Obj. V. Resultative complement.
- ba_bei_constructions (grammar): 把 / 被 -- Use 把 for an initiated disposal action, usually with a result or completion; use 被 for passive voice. Do not use 把 when the subject did not cause the event.
- negation_bu_mei (grammar): 不 for habit; 没 for non-occurrence -- Use 不 for habit, routine, willingness, or general negation; use 没 for an event that did not occur. Use 没 + V. for a negated action event.
- question_patterns (grammar): 是……吗 / repeated Wh-Q -- Form questions with the appropriate Chinese question pattern, such as 能不能吃, 知不知道, or the repeated Wh-Q pattern for “wh-ever…”.
- missing_or_unclear_subject (grammar): miss a Subj. -- State the subject when it is required for grammatical clarity, especially after an inserted narrator comment or when the previous subject cannot continue.
- perception_look_see (word_choice): 看 look vs. 看到 see -- 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and includes the result of seeing. Choose according to whether the narrative means the attempt or the achieved perception.
- search_find (word_choice): 找 look for vs. 找到 find -- 找 means “look for”; 找到 means “find” and includes the successful result.
- listen_hear (word_choice): 听 listen vs. 听到 hear -- 听 is “listen”; 听到 is “hear” and expresses the result of perceiving a sound.
- near_synonym_precision (word_choice): near-synonyms: choose the intended word -- Choose the near-synonym whose meaning fits the intended event, duration, possibility, or degree; similar-looking words are not interchangeable.
- collocation_selection (word_choice): word collocation -- Use words with their normal collocations; a grammatically possible combination may still not be a natural Chinese phrase.
- word_class_choice (word_choice): word class -- Choose the word class required by the structure, for example noun, adjective, adverb, or verb, rather than using a related word of the wrong class.
- fixed_expressions (word_choice): fixed expression -- Use conventional fixed expressions and established compounds rather than creating a literal or nonstandard combination.
- formal_register (word_choice): formal words and register -- Choose words that fit the register of the sentence; some words are formal, conversational, or used only in a particular context.
- specific_noun_choice (word_choice): be specific -- Use a specific noun when the story requires one; avoid overly general words such as 人, 东西, 事情, 水果, or vague 有麻烦.
- other_vs_additional (word_choice): 别的 vs. 另外 -- 别的 means a different type or all others except the one mentioned. 另外 means an additional quantity or another/the other.
- laoshi_negative_repetition (word_choice): 老是 for something negative -- 老是 means “always” with a negative or complaining tone; do not use it for a neutral or positive repeated action.
- haide_harmful_result (word_choice): 害得 + N/sb. + harmful result -- 害得 is followed by a person or noun and a genuinely harmful result. Do not use it for a neutral event such as 搬家 or 玩儿, or for a merely mild feeling.
- become_and_profession (word_choice): 成为 + N. / 成才 -- 成为 is followed by an appropriate noun, especially a profession or public identity; use 成才 rather than a literal phrase for becoming successful or capable.
- ask_request_verbs (word_choice): 问 vs. ask for help / ask sb. to do -- 问 is for asking a question. Use the appropriate verb for “ask for help” or “ask somebody to do something.”
- wrong_character (word_choice): use the wrong character -- Use the correct written Chinese character for the intended word or adverbial form.
- first_mention_introduction (coherence_reference): 1st time, briefly introduce N. -- The first time a story character appears, introduce the person with a brief identifying noun phrase rather than using only the name or pronoun.
- ambiguous_pronoun (coherence_reference): “他/她/它” is ambiguous -- Use a pronoun only when its referent is close and unambiguous. Repeat the name or use a clear noun phrase when more than one possible referent intervenes.
- pronoun_name_zero_reference (coherence_reference): re-occur: pronoun, zero, or N. -- For a re-occurring referent, use a pronoun when it is close, zero form within the same clause, and repeat the noun/name when it is far away or something intervenes. Avoid too many repeated names or too many pronouns.
- demonstrative_reference (coherence_reference): 这个/这种 + N. must be clear -- Use 这个, 这种, 这些, and 有的 only when the preceding context identifies exactly which entity or set they refer to.
- possessive_reference (coherence_reference): 他的/她的 implies ownership -- Do not use a possessive pronoun when it wrongly implies ownership or leaves the owner unclear; use a more precise relationship expression instead.
- zero_redundant_pronoun (coherence_reference): zero form: delete redundant pronoun -- Within the same clause or a close continuation, omit a repeated subject or possessive when Chinese naturally uses zero form.
- le_completed (coherence_temporality): 了 completed -- Use 了 for a completed action or a change of state in the narrative. Do not add it merely because an action verb appears.
- no_le_mental_state (coherence_temporality): mental state V.: no 了 -- Mental-state verbs such as 决定 and 发现 normally take zero particle when expressing the state, decision, or discovery in this narrative use.
- no_le_routine_state (coherence_temporality): no 了 for routine/habit -- Use zero particle for routines, habits, repeated conditions, and states, especially with 常常, 每天, 有的时候, and similar expressions.
- no_le_speaking_word (coherence_temporality): no 了 for speaking word -- A saying word that introduces quoted speech normally uses zero particle, not 了.
- no_le_with_mei (coherence_temporality): 没 + V., no 了 -- After 没/没有 for a non-occurring action, do not add 了 to the action verb.
- zhe_durative (coherence_temporality): 着 durative -- Use 着 for a durative, accompanying, or static state, including an accompanying action such as V.着 + V2.
- zai_progressive (coherence_temporality): 在/正在 ongoing -- Use 在/正在 for a dynamic action that is ongoing. Do not use it when the sentence is only stating a location or does not emphasize an ongoing action.
- guo_experience (coherence_temporality): 过 for experience -- Use 过 to mean “have done/have experienced.” Do not use it when the stated experience has not happened yet.
- action_series_last_le (coherence_temporality): a series of actions: last one with 了 -- When narrating a series of actions, use the aspect marking to organize the sequence; normally the final completed action takes 了.
- time_sequence_markers (coherence_temporality): Time + 以后 / 后来 -- Use Time + 以后 and 后来 to show a clear temporal sequence, and avoid redundant time expressions.
- cause_result_soyi (coherence_connectors): 所以: cause-result relationship -- Use 所以 only when the preceding clause is genuinely the cause or reason for the following result. Otherwise delete it or use a connector that matches the relationship.
- purpose_weile (coherence_connectors): 为了 + VP. -- Use 为了 + verb phrase to state a purpose, in the appropriate clause position; do not use it as a result connector.
- adversative_connector (coherence_connectors): 可是/却/而: semantic turn -- Use 可是, 却, 而, and 但 only when there is a real contrast, unexpected semantic turn, or concession. Do not add an adversative connector without that relationship.
- addition_repetition_connectors (coherence_connectors): 又 / 也 / 还 / 并 -- Use additive and repetition connectors according to their meanings: 又 for repetition, 也 for similarity, 还 for an added or surprising point, and 并 to strengthen a coherent addition.
- conditional_jiu (coherence_connectors): 只要……就 / Subj. + 就 -- Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and place the subject and 就 so that the conditional or natural continuation relationship is clear.
- not_but_refutation (coherence_connectors): 不是……而是…… -- 不是……而是…… refutes something conventional or mistaken and affirms an unexpected correction. Use it only when the two alternatives have that correction relationship.
- either_or_choice (coherence_connectors): 不是……就是…… -- 不是……就是…… means “either…or…” and requires two genuinely alternative possibilities, not two compatible purposes, states, or actions.
- he_scope_coordination (coherence_connectors): 和 cannot connect clauses/verb phrases -- 和/跟 + noun connects multiple nouns that share the same action. Do not use it to connect whole clauses, unrelated verb phrases, adjectives, or an accompanying object that does not perform the action.
- example_emphasis_connectors (coherence_connectors): 比方说 / 特别是 -- 比方说 introduces an example; delete it when no example follows. 特别是 + N, + clause singles out a typical example and must match the category being exemplified.
- loose_clause_connection (coherence_connectors): loose connection / no logic relationship -- Make the relationship between clauses and sentences explicit. Add an appropriate connector, purpose, condition, place, or sequence marker when the narrative is fractured or loosely connected.
- condition_not_definite (coherence_connectors): condition is not definite -- Before expressions such as 这就要看……了, state an uncertain condition or alternative, for example 会不会生病 or 要不要吃.
- incorrect_story_information (content): wrong information -- Retell the traditional story accurately: do not add people, places, actions, objects, or character identities that are not in the story, and do not change established facts.
- missing_story_information (content): miss information / result -- Include the important scene, action, motivation, or result needed for a complete retelling, rather than leaving a key event unexplained.
- redundant_words (other): redundant -- Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures that add no meaning or repeat information already expressed.
- expressive_detail_and_description (other): add descriptive detail -- Use clear descriptive detail and internal-state language where needed so the retelling has sufficient scenes and is more expressive, not only a bare sequence of events.
- other (other): other -- Fits no other category.
